purpose: Re-rank after the first genuine low-novelty batch and decide whether to widen to BAT-CELL or independently test persistence of UP-CHEMICALS saturation.

campaign_state.interpretation: UP-CHEMICALS ordinary-gap-batch4-v6 is the first low-novelty observation: zero new categories, two useful refinements and three duplicates. It is not seal-eligible. The next decision must distinguish genuine saturation confirmation from mechanically opening another shard.

refinements: converter train-level ramp-guidance revisions as dated expectation vintages
feed-to-WIP-to-finished-delivery material balance as a point-in-time reconciliation chain
duplicate_dimensions: first product versus stable customer-qualified battery-grade output

BAT-CELL.reason: The deterministic compact layer already separates battery production/sales/installed/export GWh, multi-stage cell inventory, formation/aging constraints, yield, customer nomination-to-SOP, dedicated/captive capacity and vehicle-installation timing. DOWN-NEV's new demand bridge therefore does not currently expose a first-order BAT-CELL negative-space cell.

UP-HARDROCK.reason: Its v6 result remained high information at two new categories, two refinements and one duplicate; immediate return would be local drilling before more mature shards are tested for saturation.

DOWN-NEV.reason: Its v6 result also remained high information and already made the battery-production/installation/material-intensity bridge explicit.

UP-CHEMICALS.reason: It is the only shard with a qualifying low-novelty observation. A second probe is justified only because it changes lens: test failure/dead-end paths, reversible project states and expectation revisions rather than repeating the conversion-realization dimensions just audited. This measures whether low novelty persists across independent negative-space lenses.

inputs_allowed: current UP-CHEMICALS deterministic compact index including batch4-v6
inputs_forbidden: later outcomes used to manufacture hindsight precision
next_probe.classification_rule: Preserve duplicates. If any materially new first-order replay category appears, classify it new_category and reset consecutive_low_novelty_batches to zero. Do not protect the streak.
next_probe.low_novelty_rule: A second low-novelty result may advance UP-CHEMICALS to streak=2 only if it contains no materially new replay category and the remaining outputs are refinements or duplicates.
next_probe.after_probe: Re-rank again. Do not auto-run a third batch merely because streak=2; the third probe must use another independently justified negative-space lens before a seal review can even be considered.
